Colestyramine significantly reduces the absorption of levothyroxine by binding with thyroid hormones in the gastrointestinal tract. The malabsorption of levothyroxine is minimised by allowing an interval of 4 to 5 hours to elapse be- tween taking the two drugs.1 A similar effect has been seen with sodium polystyrene sulfonate.2 1. Ann Intern Med 1992; 117: 1010–13. Lipid regulating drugs. Both decreased efficacy1 and in- creased efficacy2 of levothyroxine have been reported in individ- ual patients given lovastatin.
